name: USS Enterprise CVN-65
description: The USS Enterprise nuclear-powered aircraft carrier began construction on February 4, 1958, entered service on November 25, 1961, and held a decommissioning ceremony in 2012. It is the first aircraft carrier in the world to use a nuclear reactor as a power source and the first-generation nuclear-powered aircraft carrier of the US military. The USS Enterprise has served in the U.S. Navy for 51 years and is the longest-serving aircraft carrier in the Navy. It has participated in the Vietnam War, many wars in the Gulf and the Bosnia-Herzegovina War. During its lifetime of service, it has traveled all over the world.
